violation_type.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 2 years of age and within weight and height limit of child safety seat (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 2 years of age and within weight and height limit of child safety seat
violation_type.typical_finding: 3 of the 35 child safety seats were expired. This was corrected during the inspection when the child safety seats were removed from the operation.

finding_variants.text: 3 of the 35 child safety seats were expired. This was corrected during the inspection when the child safety seats were removed from the operation.
11 of the 35 child safety seats were expired. No children were transported and the operation corrected the seats when they removed all the expired seats from the vehicles.
During today's inspection a three year old child was transported without a child passenger safety seat. Note: The director added a booster seat in the vehicle during inspection.
The incorrect safety seat is being used to transport a 2 year old child. The safety seat being used is not equipped with a harness.
